meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先读取仓库状态,再按需提交改动、整理或改写提交历史,或追查某行代码何时、被谁改动,并在回复里给出 commit 哈希和命令证据。你没明确要求时,它不会提交、推送或改写历史。
howto.when: 当你要求提交改动、整理提交历史(如 rebase、squash),或追查某次改动的时间与作者时会接管;普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把当前改动整理成几个清晰的提交
say.note: 它先读状态,再按原子分组逐个提交

say.text: 这行代码最后是谁改的?哪次提交改的?
say.note: 用 git blame 给出提交哈希和作者

say.text: 把最近几个提交压缩成一个
say.note: 走 rebase 流程,改写前先确认仓库状态

howto.what_en: Claude handles git work: it reads repo state first, then commits changes, tidies history, or traces when a line changed, citing commit hashes and command evidence. It won't commit, push, or rewrite history unless you ask.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a commit, a history rewrite (rebase, squash), or a git-history question like who or which commit changed something. Ordinary code edits don't trigger it.

say_en.text: Tidy my current changes into a few clean commits
say_en.note: It reads status, then commits each atomic group

say_en.text: Who last changed this line, and in which commit?
say_en.note: Uses git blame with hash and author

say_en.text: Squash my recent commits into one
say_en.note: Runs a rebase after checking repo state
